fields.climate: maritime; wet, moderate winters, cool summers
fields.terrain: marshy, lowlands; flat in the north, hilly in the south
fields.hazards: sometimes flooding occurs in the spring
fields.resources: oil shale, peat, rare earth elements, phosphorite, clay, limestone, sand, dolomite, arable land, sea mud
fields.farm: milk, wheat, barley, rapeseed, peas, oats, potatoes, rye, pork, triticale
fields.exports: cars, wood, broadcasting equipment, refined petroleum, prefabricated buildings
fields.industries: food, engineering, electronics, wood and wood products, textiles; information technology, telecommunications
fields.religions: Orthodox 16.5%, Protestant 9.2% (Lutheran 7.7%, other Protestant 1.5%), other 3% (includes Roman Catholic, Muslim, Jehovah's Witness, Pentecostal, Buddhist, and Taara Believer), none 58.4%…
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal; age 16 for local elections
fields.military: 18-27 for compulsory military or governmental service for men; conscript service requirement 8-11 months depending on education…
